about: Reviewed corrections to sankhyah.source-data.json (2026-11-13). The source file is left verbatim, as its editorial rules require; SankhyahPage applies these on top.
references: Pāṇini 6.3.47–49 (द्वा-, त्रयः-, अष्टा- in numeral compounds); 6.1.77, 6.1.87–88, 6.1.101 (vowel sandhi)
Bhāskara II, Līlāvatī, paribhāṣā (names of the decimal places)
largerNote: The source's names from 10⁹ on (अर्बुद 10⁹, खर्व 10¹¹, नील 10¹³, पद्म 10¹⁵, शङ्ख 10¹⁷) follow the modern Hindi scale (अरब, खरब …). In Bhāskara's Līlāvatī the places are ten-fold: अयुत 10⁴, लक्ष 10⁵, प्रयुत 10⁶, कोटि 10⁷, अर्बुद 10⁸, अब्ज 10⁹, खर्व 10¹⁰, निखर्व 10¹¹, महापद्म 10¹², शङ्कु 10¹³, जलधि 10¹⁴, अन्त्य 10¹⁵, मध्य 10¹⁶, परार्ध 10¹⁷.
